metadata.case_name: HUSSAIN SHOUKAT v. MA CHI TAT AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: general labourer (casual work at construction sites and loading and unloading)
plaintiff.education_level: educated to primary level so he is unable to read even in his on language

injuries.description: Intertrochanteric fracture of the left femur
source: (i) Intertrochanteric fracture of the left femur
x-rays revealed fractures of both wrists and the left hip.

injuries.description: Comminuted fracture of the left distal radius and fracture of the ulna
injuries.body_part: left distal radius and ulna / left forearm / left wrist
source: (ii) Comminuted fracture of the left distal radius and fracture of the ulna
On 24 July 2006 the Plaintiff was underwent an operation of open reduction and internal fixation of the left forearm
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of both ulna and radius

injuries.description: Fracture of the distal radius of the right wrist
source: (iii) Fracture of the distal radius of the right wrist
x-rays revealed fractures of both wrists and the left hip.
His right wrist was immobilized by Plaster-of-Paris.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Multiple facial and skull vault fractures
source: (iv) Multiple facial and skull vault fractures
The Plaintiff also suffered loss of consciousness and post traumatic amnesia for about 9 hours. He also suffered multiple facial and skull vault fractures.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

manifestations.description: loss of consciousness and post traumatic amnesia for about 9 hours
post-concussion syndrome which caused headaches and dizziness
slight limitation of left hip movement
diffuse tenderness of the left hip and left lower limb with some unilateral muscle wasting of left thigh suggesting some degree of persistent pain and disuse of the left lower limb
limitation of movements of the left wrist; muscle slightly weak and slight unilateral muscle atrophy of left forearm and arm; the grip was weak and so was the muscle power of the left wrist
x-rays of the left wrist on examination showed some irregularity at the joint surface suggesting some articular surface damage. The chance of post traumatic arthritis remains high for the left wrist.
The Plaintiff has impaired ability to exert heavily with his hand
He should not be able to return to work as a construction site worker

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of the left forearm
close reduction and internal fixation of the left hip
physiotherapy for 4 – 5 months at Yan Chai Hospital
occupational therapy for 3 – 4 months at Princess Margaret Hospital

losses.description: The Plaintiff has impaired ability to exert heavily with his hand.
Prolonged walking when carrying weight and some limitation of left hip movement.
He should not be able to return to work as a construction site worker.

comparable_cases.injury_description: very similar to but a bit more serious than that in this case
